text:
rachel: Opened a small PR to rationalize streaming + pagination snippets across py/ts/go. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512. Goals: canonicalize resume cursor to "" (empty string), show per-call deadline patterns, and add a 1-line knob cheat note. Can folks sanity-check?
tom: skimmed. TS snippet should use AbortController and show a stop-after-N pattern (backpressure). note: abort may still surface a final partial event from the server, call that out.
priya: for Python prefer `async for chunk in client.responses.stream(...)` and wrap the whole call in `asyncio.wait_for(..., timeout=0.25)` for a per-call deadline. less error-prone than manual loop+break.
tom: quick TS example I propose: ```ts
const ac = new AbortController();
const s = client.responses.stream({model: 'redwood-mini', input: q, signal: ac.signal});
let count = 0;
for await (const p of s) { handle(p); if (++count >= 40) ac.abort(); }
```
priya: python snippet: ```py
async def run(q):
  async for chunk in client.responses.stream(model='redwood-mini', input=q):
    process(chunk)
await asyncio.wait_for(run(q), timeout=0.25)
```
rachel: for Go let's show context timeout + resume token in the request headers so people see the pattern: ```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 250*time.Millisecond)
defer cancel()
req.Headers.Set("x-resume-token", token)
stream, err := client.StreamResponses(ctx, req)
for stream.Next() { ev := stream.Event(); handle(ev) }
```
tom: one nit: older snippets used both null and "" for cursor. good to normalize. add a short sentence: "Use "" to request the first page; servers return a resume token when available."
priya: added a tiny FAQ blurb: "Resume tokens are opaque strings (often base64). Treat them as a handle to pass back to `cursor`. Do not attempt to parse."
docs-bot: PR 512 updated: snippet smoke-tests passed, docs linter green.
rachel: added a 1-line knob cheat under the examples: "batching -> higher throughput; small per-call deadlines -> bounded latency; TTL cache -> fewer cold starts." merging in 10m unless objections.
tom: lgtm
priya: lgtm
rachel: thanks all, will watch release-notes bot and follow up if users ask for expanded examples.
